title: feat(publish-script): re-write as js script, allow beta releases
body:
Related to #2056 

I have re-written the release script in javascript to enhance the user experience when doing a new release and also to allow releases from another branch than develop for beta releases.

Here is the flow:

* if branch === develop -> do normal release
* if branch === master -> ask to be on develop for normal release or another branch for beta
* if branch !== develop || branch !== master -> ask if user wants to release a beta

**In case of beta, ask for a new version number with -beta.x suffix**

* [x] Allow stable releases
* [x] Allow beta releases
* [x] Revert changes if process does not go until the end
* [x] Refactoring of duplicated code (for different releases cycles)
